thesis: A learned pre-generation Policy Manager conditionally allocates emotional-support strategy and typed longitudinal-memory resources, preserving or improving public benchmark outcomes while reducing measured resource cost relative to non-adaptive high-resource baselines.

step1.role: The only policy decision layer: score component opportunities and project them through task, safety, budget, and conflict masks into one legal joint action.

step2.role: Execute the already-selected legal action with exact typed candidates and the task adapter; never reopen component ON/OFF decisions.

ES_MemEval_QA_and_Summary.legal_action_surface: eight memory subsets with R0 fixed

ES_MemEval_Dialogue_Generation.legal_action_surface: eight memory subsets with one fixed common strategy condition
ES_MemEval_Dialogue_Generation.role: Official-aligned response evaluation of memory allocation; not official evidence for MetaCom's four-head 16-action joint policy.

optional_future_joint_adaptation.activation_rule: Only after official ESConv, ESC-Eval, and ES-MemEval results show that an essential one-PM integration claim remains unidentifiable.
optional_future_joint_adaptation.possible_design: A minimal preregistered RS fixed/off by memory-policy extension on ES-MemEval dialogue generation.
optional_future_joint_adaptation.naming_boundary: MetaCom supplemental adaptation, never an official ES-MemEval condition.

prompt_invariance.within_task: Same base task prompt, generator, decoding, and output handling across arms; only the legitimately selected strategy or memory resource block may differ.
prompt_invariance.across_tasks: Use each benchmark's official task adapter; literal prompt equality across ESC, QA, summarization, and dialogue generation is neither possible nor required.

strategy.official_learning_source: ESConv strategy taxonomy and official train/dev structure
strategy.primary_outcome_exam: ESC-Eval official protocol and seven dimensions

heads.MP: stable profile, preference, and user constraint

memory.primary_exam: ES-MemEval-Public-v1.0.0-1427 official QA, summarization, and dialogue-generation tasks

research_questions.question: Does the frozen generator have adequate observable emotional-support capability for the study?
research_questions.outcomes: Official seven-dimension profile, completion/reliability, and Cost; no invented official pass line.

research_questions.question: Does a learned strategy policy allocate emotional-support actions better than absent or non-adaptive strategy policies?
Does a learned typed-memory policy improve the official long-term-memory performance-cost tradeoff?

primary_success_shape.generator: RQ0 is completed and one reproducible same-stack generator is selected from official outcomes, reliability, and Cost without claiming an ESC-Eval official pass certificate.
primary_success_shape.strategy: Learned strategy allocation shows value over Vanilla and/or matched Random on official ESConv/ESC-Eval outcomes.
primary_success_shape.memory_system: Learned typed-memory allocation shows a better official-outcome/Cost tradeoff than Full History and/or official fixed RAG.
primary_success_shape.overall: generator AND strategy AND memory_system AND typed_memory

useful_memory_head_definition.metric_authority: Only ES-MemEval official task metrics; no custom Function or Quality score.
useful_memory_head_definition.eligibility: Outcome-blind semantic mapping of official instances to MP/MS/ME before model outcomes are inspected.
useful_memory_head_definition.contrast: Same-stack full system versus full-minus-head on that eligible slice.
useful_memory_head_definition.minimum_evidence: Nonzero directionally correct paired improvement replicated in at least two independent user or fact/event clusters, with nonnegative net eligible-slice effect and user-cluster uncertainty reported.
useful_memory_head_definition.stronger_optional_evidence: Per-head aggregate statistical significance is reportable but is not required for every head in Paper 1.
useful_memory_head_definition.insufficient_surface: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_ON_THIS_BENCHMARK and cannot count toward the two-head requirement.

generalization_scope.required: Held-out evaluation instances or strict temporal suffixes whose query, gold outcome, and future sessions were unavailable during fitting.
generalization_scope.claim_boundary: Performance and adaptive value on the public benchmark user/task distribution; not fully independent real-user population generalization.

statistical_units.ESConv: dialogue; turns are repeated within dialogue
statistical_units.ESC-Eval: role-card dialogue; turns and dimensions are repeated measures
statistical_units.ES-MemEval: user (18); questions, summaries, and scenarios are repeated within user

official_first_metrics.ES-MemEval: Use task-specific official metrics separately for QA, summarization, and dialogue generation.
official_first_metrics.project_metric: Cost only: tokens, retrieval/embedding compute, retries, latency, and USD.

published_reference.reason: Published generators, prompts, context windows, revisions, and runtimes differ from the MetaCom study stack.

official_protocol_sanity_reproduction.role: Validate dataset split, prompt assembly, retrieval, scorer, and metric direction with a representative official configuration.
official_protocol_sanity_reproduction.scope: Do not rerun every historical Mistral, Phi, GPT, or other published configuration unless a specific reproducibility question requires it.

same_stack_baseline_rerun.role: Primary causal comparison for PM value.
same_stack_baseline_rerun.allowed_difference: Only the named strategy or memory-allocation condition and the context it legitimately selects.

evidence_source_roles.ESConv: strategy learning and official held-out strategy experiment
evidence_source_roles.ESC-Eval: generator prerequisite and external strategy-outcome exam
evidence_source_roles.ES-MemEval: primary typed-memory system and component-ablation exam
evidence_source_roles.EvoEmo: retained diagnostic/supplement only; not a required primary track or independent population

source_overlap_rule.current_generator_qualification: No PM training is involved, so the English-331 full run remains valid for generator qualification.
source_overlap_rule.future_strategy_pm: Report all 331 cards, but use non-ESConv-source cards for the primary cross-source analysis after ESConv training; also exclude ExTES-source cards if ExTES enters training.

explicit_nonclaims: all four legacy heads have independent causal value
MP, MS, ME, and RS each pass on every dataset
all three memory heads are statistically significant
independent causal identification of strategy-by-memory interaction
execution_order: Complete the active ESC-Eval English-331 official-protocol generator comparison and select one frozen generator.

Run a bounded official-protocol sanity reproduction for ESConv and ES-MemEval, then rerun the official baseline conditions and usage-matched Random on the frozen same-stack generator with a complete Cost ledger.

Materialize one factorized PM interface: four Step-1 heads, task action mask and joint projection, one legal action, and one typed Step-2 executor; reuse valid causal-boundary and cost-accounting assets, not legacy pass gates.
Run RQ1 on ESConv held-out data and ESC-Eval non-ESConv-source primary analysis.
Run RQ2 on complete ES-MemEval public v1.0.0 with outcome-blind head eligibility and component-minus ablations.
Report official outcomes, clustered uncertainty, Cost, head contribution, and exact claim boundary.
Add a minimal preregistered supplemental analysis only if an essential claim is structurally unidentifiable from official tasks.
default_blocked_as_drift: new small head panels used to tune prompts or judges
EvoEmo as a required third primary pass track
per-head pass requirements on every dataset
outcome-informed changes to slices, baselines, metrics, or statistical units
